label: Independent external validation
objective: Acquire genuinely independent human replication, methodological/statistical review, adversarial review, or external evaluation of HumanAIOS/Lasting Light AI claims.
satisfied_when: A sufficiently independent human/domain reviewer or replication team completes a provenance-bearing review or replication artifact against a bounded claim set.

label: Paid human work capacity
objective: Acquire project funding, fellowship support, or research access that can support bounded human research, engineering, review, evaluation, or founder/research labor where program rules permit.
satisfied_when: Qualified human effort is fundable or accessible for a defined work package with scope, role, budget/support basis, and an output receipt.

label: Dedicated local or edge compute
objective: Acquire CPU/GPU or dedicated local/edge compute only when an admitted workload cannot be adequately substituted by existing Azure/cloud/API resources.
activation_condition: A bounded workload demonstrates cloud/API substitution failure, a privacy/locality requirement, hardware-I/O requirement, or materially inadequate capacity/cost.

label: Physical experimental equipment
objective: Acquire project-specific computers, sensors, edge devices, robotics, or actuation hardware only for an admitted experiment whose physical behavior cannot be validated in software/cloud simulation alone.
activation_condition: An admitted physical-control experiment identifies a non-substitutable physical observation or actuation requirement.
